sample_texts: Nudge counts scrolls and unlocks with an Android accessibility service. Nothing is tracked, and there's no score, until it's on.
Find Nudge under Downloaded apps (or Installed apps) and switch it on.
Optional: allow Display over other apps to show the floating scroll-count bubble.
Nudge counts your scrolls to help you track your phone use. It only learns that a scroll happened and in which app. It cannot read text or anything else on your screen.
Allow Nudge Scroll Tracker to have full control of your device?
Full control is appropriate for apps that help you with accessibility needs, but not for most apps.
It can read all content on the screen and display content over other apps.
It can track your interactions with an app or a hardware sensor, and interact with apps on your behalf.

app_chain_summary_zh: 专注自律类应用以“统计滑动/解锁、显示计数气泡”为由，引导开启无障碍服务和悬浮窗，并跳转系统无障碍列表、服务详情及全控件警告。用户点Deny拒权后仍被留在主界面诱导页，缺少关闭或替代路径，形成TRAPPED_ON_LURE_SCREEN。
observed_lure_rhetoric_zh: “Nudge counts scrolls and unlocks with an Android accessibility service. Nothing is tracked, and there's no score, until it's on.” -> 用无障碍服务统计滑动与解锁，开启前不追踪、不计分（主界面）
“Find Nudge under Downloaded apps (or Installed apps) and switch it on.” -> 到已下载/已安装应用中找到Nudge并开启（主界面）
“Optional: allow Display over other apps to show the floating scroll-count bubble.” -> 可选允许悬浮窗以显示滑动计数气泡（主界面）

“Nudge counts your scrolls to help you track your phone use. It only learns that a scroll happened and in which app. It cannot read text or anything else on your screen.” -> 宣称仅统计滑动及所在应用，不能读取屏幕文本（服务详情页）

“Allow Nudge Scroll Tracker to have full control of your device? Full control is appropriate for apps that help you with accessibility needs, but not for most apps.” -> 系统警告询问是否授予完整设备控制，提醒多数应用不适用（系统警告弹窗）
“View and control screen / It can read all content on the screen and display content over other apps.” -> 可查看控制屏幕、读取全部屏幕内容并悬浮显示（系统警告弹窗）
“View and perform actions / It can track your interactions with an app or a hardware sensor, and interact with apps on your behalf.” -> 可跟踪与应用或硬件传感器交互并代为操作应用（系统警告弹窗）

frame_captions_zh.step_01: 主界面展示“nudge”与0滑动/解锁，文案称无障碍仅统计滑动和解锁、启用前不记录；点击“Open accessibility settings”跳系统页。
frame_captions_zh.step_02: 系统无障碍页“DOWNLOADED APPS(已下载应用)”下Nudge Scroll Tracker显示Off(关闭)；捕获设置钩子后自动终止，服务未开启。
frame_captions_zh.post_jump_0.8s: 仍停留系统无障碍设置页，0.8秒探针未采集到界面文本，overlays=0，无通知横幅或遮罩。
frame_captions_zh.post_jump_2.0s: 同一系统无障碍设置页等待2.0秒，界面文本仍为空，overlays=0，未见通知、横幅或遮罩弹层。
frame_captions_zh.detail_1_service_detail_page: 服务详情页显示“Use Nudge Scroll Tracker(使用Nudge滚动追踪器)”及快捷方式Off；说明称只知滑动及所在应用，不能读屏。
frame_captions_zh.detail_2_system_warning_dialog: 系统全控件警告弹窗称可查看控制屏幕、读取全部内容并悬浮显示、跟踪交互；提供Allow(允许)/Deny(拒绝)，本步仅检查。
frame_captions_zh.refusal_2.0s: 点Deny拒权2秒后返回主界面，仍显示开启无障碍与悬浮窗引导，计数0，无关闭入口，判定TRAPPED_ON_LURE_SCREEN。
frame_captions_zh.refusal_10.5s: 拒权10.5秒后仍停同一主界面诱导页，无障碍与悬浮窗按钮未消失，计数0，无取消/退出，维持TRAPPED_ON_LURE_SCREEN。
